title: GET /api/log
description: Entries newest first (ts, id). Filters: category, range today|7d (none = whole retention), client_id, owner, profile_id, area_id, kind, q (search, _ and % literal), unread; paging before_id + limit (1–500, default 100). Entries older than the retention are never returned. GET /api/log/export answers the same shape without paging (max 20000).
